says: In today's tooling, .agents/skills/tests/scripts/plant.ts is in no typecheck, so its type error (TS2769 at line 53, the vitest options as a readonly tuple) went unseen; the error is fixed, but plant.ts cannot join .agents/tsconfig.json yet, because it imports the root vitest.config.ts, and the files that config reaches outside .agents/ then fail the .agents program on duplicate @demlik/tea warnings.
proof: With plant.ts, plant.test.ts and fixtures/plant/*.ts added to .agents/tsconfig.json's include (and allowJs, for oxlint-plugins/script-reads.mjs), `pnpm run typecheck` in .agents/ exits 1 with no error and five `warning TS377051: Multiple versions of package @demlik/tea` lines, on ../oxlint-plugins/script-reads.mjs, ../vitest.changed.ts, ../vitest.config.ts, ../vitest.hostrun.ts and ../vitest.shards.ts. The allowance in tsconfig.base.json (line 124) covers only `.agents/**/*.ts`, and oxlint-plugins/duplicate-packages.test.ts (law E3, line 74) refuses any include outside `.agents/`, so widening it would loosen that law. Before the fix, the same run printed `skills/tests/scripts/plant.ts(53,43): error TS2769: No overload matches this call`; after it, no error.
cost: A type error in the tests step's plant tool lands unseen, and the next change to vitest's Node API or to the repo's test config breaks plant.ts only when a tests step runs it.
